base_plans.intermediate_grain: rows of fact 'shipments' aligned to dimensions ['region']; native fact multiplicity preserved, LEFT JOINs are many-to-one
base_plans.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(f__region."region_id", '__metriclayer__::missing_member__') AS "dim__region", 1 AS "measure"
  FROM "shipments" f
  LEFT JOIN "regions" f__region ON f__region."region_id" = f."region_id"

base_plans.intermediate_grain: rows of fact 'shipments' aligned to dimensions ['region']; native fact multiplicity preserved, LEFT JOINs are many-to-one
base_plans.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(f__region."region_id", '__metriclayer__::missing_member__') AS "dim__region", "f"."amount" AS "measure", CASE WHEN "f"."amount" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "measure_is_null"
  FROM "shipments" f
  LEFT JOIN "regions" f__region ON f__region."region_id" = f."region_id"

read_view: single SQLite read transaction; one read-only connection per query, all per-fact SQL run against the same snapshot
notes: each base metric reads exactly one fact table at its native row grain; facts are never joined to facts
existence filters compile to independent NOT/IN semi-joins; two existence filters are evaluated independently and may be satisfied by different fact rows
